README.md:
Edit layout.json to rearrange this workspace’s activity. Keep each named section once. To group sections, replace them in the list with {"display": "stack", "title": "Update", "sections": ["headline", "details"]}. Use columns for a side-by-side group on wide screens. Set postsPerPage in client.js to show between 1 and 50 updates. Publish the revision to update this workspace. In server.js, env.TEDIX.connectionsCall can call tools granted through a bound connection.

The overview’s running section contains Needs you, Decided for you, By area, Running by area, and Live and held. Following uses the person’s selected projects. The area lead can maintain project.metadata.activityOverview with observedAt (ISO timestamp), changed (today’s result), next, and releases. Each release has state (live or held), label, detail (what shipped or why it is held), at (ISO timestamp), and href (a /work/items/<id> or /work/projects/<id> evidence link). Read the project first and preserve its other metadata when updating it. Reports show their dates; a finished task without a release report is never described as deployed.

For a result with a workspace file, submit the saved revision as Work evidence using output://<output-id>/revisions/<revision-id>. Readers can preview that version in Activity.
